_source: The Incorporated Trustees of the Islamic Community Fund of Hong Kong, 'Fasting Time-Table for Ramadan 1447 A.H. (2026)', images/2026/poster/02_feb/timetable2026.pdf hosted on iuhk.org (found via the Islamic Union of Hong Kong article '2026年齋月齋拜時間表', news id 2289)
_publisher_tier: authority (the Trustees are the statutory body that owns and runs Hong Kong's mosques; the sheet is their own printing)
_stated_rules: Day 1 is conditional on sighting: 'If the moon is sighted on Tuesday 17 February 2026 (29th Sha'ban) then fasting will commence from Wednesday 18 February 2026, otherwise from Thursday 19 February 2026.' The sheet prints day 1 as 19 February. Also printed: 'It is advised to call Azan for Fajr prayer 5 minutes after the time of Suhoor', and 'The Sadqa-tul-Fitr for this year is a minimum of HK$30 per person'.
_observations: Iftar matches the Trustees' own full-year masjid maghrib column (sunset + 4..5); suhoor runs 5 minutes before that table's fajr adhan, which is the printed instruction, not a separate computation.
_cross_check: Printed full-year sheet, February block: maghrib 18:26 on 18 Feb, 18:29 on 24 Feb; this Ramadan sheet prints iftar 18:25 on 19 Feb and 18:28 on 25 Feb - the same curve one day on.
